assessment.message: This stretch may work, with some risks.
reasons: Little difference in how near and far details move. This may be a pan; move through the place, rather than only turning.

explanation.diagnostic: The camera path could not be worked out: the frames show the scene from too nearly the same place, or share too little. Try a stretch where the camera moves more (a walk, an orbit, a low flight), or a longer stretch at fewer frames a second.
explanation.advice: What worksWalk slowly around an object, or through a place, so the camera moves sideways and sees the same things from new angles.10 to 40 seconds, held steady, in even light.Plenty of texture: stone, bark, brick, leaves, signs.No zoom, and few people or cars moving.A drone circling a building or a statue is ideal.A file under 40 MB (trim a long video first).What failsTurning on the spot, or a panorama: the camera has to move, not just turn.A tripod time-lapse: the camera never moves.Blank walls, sky or water: nothing to match.Blur from fast moves or low light.
